name: Mercedes-Benz Vans of Laguna Niguel
climate: Mild Southern California coastal/inland climate; no snow or road salt.
brandNaming: This is a Mercedes-Benz Vans store: write "Mercedes-Benz Sprinter" and "Mercedes-Benz eSprinter" (Sprinter Cargo Van, Crew Van, Passenger Van); passenger-car models belong to the sister store Mercedes-Benz of Laguna Niguel on the same 1 Star Dr campus
Write "Mercedes-Benz" in full in copy and headings; do not shorten it to "Mercedes" or "Benz"
Say service "offers" or "Service Offers", never "coupon" or "coupons" (brand terms ledger MB-001)
Say "Genuine Mercedes-Benz parts": they are recommended, never required, and never say other parts "void" a warranty
When describing MBUX or driver-assistance features, add the Mercedes-Benz "Digital Extras" availability disclaimer
Service timing follows the Operator's Manual and the Maintenance Booklet; keep every service record
